name: Zach D. Films
description: A 3D cartoon “what if” explainer short in the style of Zack D. Films-type videos, entirely in code with three.js: procedural cartoon people, props and effects, a blue studio sky, slow-motion impacts, a red force-ripple overlay, quick whip cuts and 1 to 3 word captions timed to the voiceover.
best_use_cases: Could X stop Y / what-if explainers
style: Bright blue studio sky, soft daylight, cartoon people as simple shapes with big expressive faces, metal that reads as metal. Slow motion on the impact, a short camera shake, sparks, bloom on hot things, a red ripple showing force spreading, quick cuts on caption beats and one dip to black on the “But” turn. White bold 1-3 word captions in the lower third.
